message.rbd.taboo: Before the words escape, an unseen hand grips your heart.
message.rbd.unfamiliar: You do not yet recognize the person within this book.
message.rbd.returning: The familiar world is returning to the past…
message.rbd.reading_end: The remembered sensations fade. You return to yourself.
message.rbd.welcome: A library holds the lives of the departed. Find it near X %s, Z %s.
message.rbd.empty_book: This volume has no life bound to it. Seek the memory shelves.
message.rbd.exception: Within this authored scene, your words are not restrained.
message.rbd.no_authority: You do not hold Return by Death.
screen.rbd.archive: Book of the Dead · Memory Archive
screen.rbd.empty_shelf: No visible lives rest on this shelf yet.
screen.rbd.ending.suffocation: There is no room for another breath.
gamerule.rbdAutoBindSingleplayer: RBD · Automatically grant authority in singleplayer
gamerule.rbdMaxHolders.description: Default: 1. Allowed: 0 to 2147483647. Lowering the limit prevents new grants; existing holders retain authority. All holders share one checkpoint.
gamerule.rbdAutoBindOnJoin: RBD · Automatically grant authority on join
gamerule.rbdCheckpointAdvancements.descr: Default: List.of("minecraft:story/enter_the_nether","minecraft:end/kill_dragon"). Comma-separated advancement IDs. An empty value disables advancement checkpoints; awakening still creates the first checkpoint.
gamerule.rbdRecordPlayers.description: Default: true. Authority holders are always recorded so their deaths can return the world.
gamerule.rbdGenerateArchive: RBD · Generate the archive near spawn
gamerule.rbdGenerateArchive.description: Default: true. Applies when the archive is first generated; existing structures stay in place.
gamerule.rbdArchiveOffsetX: RBD · Archive X offset from spawn
gamerule.rbdArchiveOffsetX.description: Default: 48. Allowed: -29999000 to 29999000. Applies when the archive is first generated; existing structures stay in place.
gamerule.rbdArchiveOffsetZ: RBD · Archive Z offset from spawn
gamerule.rbdArchiveOffsetZ.description: Default: 48. Allowed: -29999000 to 29999000. Applies when the archive is first generated; existing structures stay in place.
gamerule.rbdRequireRecognition: RBD · Reading requires recognizing the deceased
gamerule.rbdAllowSelfReading: RBD · Allow reading your own book
gamerule.rbdLockBodyWhileReading: RBD · Lock body controls during reading
message.rbd.invalid_rule: Invalid value: check the range or advancement IDs in Game Rules.
screen.rbd.rules_error: Game rules could not be saved
message.rbd.return_paused: The world return is paused. Your connection is retained. The server owner can inspect the server log.
gamerule.rbdPhantomEnabled.description: Trigger at the miasma threshold. Disabling dismisses existing phantoms.
gamerule.rbdPhantomMiasmaThreshold.descr: Default 10; targets Return by Death holders.
gamerule.rbdPhantomCheckTicks.descriptio: Encounter check interval in ticks; 20 ticks = one second.
gamerule.rbdPhantomEncounterCooldownTick: Cooldown after defeat or departure; retained with the soul across returns, in ticks.
gamerule.rbdPhantomSpawnDistance.descrip: Search for safe ground at this distance from the target, in blocks.
gamerule.rbdPhantomAbsentTargetTicks.des: Ticks to wait after the target logs out, dies, or enters spectator mode.
gamerule.rbdPhantomBaseHealth.descriptio: Base health = this value + target maximum health × health scale.
gamerule.rbdPhantomPlayerHealthScale.des: Health added from the target when mirrored; native equipment effects also apply.
gamerule.rbdPhantomBaseDamage.descriptio: Base attack = this value + target attack damage × damage scale.
gamerule.rbdPhantomPlayerDamageScale.des: Attack damage added from the target when mirrored.
gamerule.rbdPhantomMovementSpeed.descrip: Base speed; learning and native equipment effects also apply.
gamerule.rbdPhantomSecondPhaseHealthRati: Default 0.5. A lethal first-phase hit also enters phase two.
Health fraction on entering phase two.
gamerule.rbdPhantomAuraWarningTicks.desc: Delay from entering phase two until aura executions, in ticks.
gamerule.rbdPhantomSlaughterAura.descrip: In phase two, executes all living entities except the locked target and itself, including allies, pets and other bosses; totems do not prevent it.
gamerule.rbdPhantomAuraRange.description: Default 32-block sphere; affects loaded living entities in the phantom’s current dimension.
gamerule.rbdPhantomAuraIntervalTicks.des: Time between execution pulses, in ticks.
gamerule.rbdPhantomSecondPhaseBoons.desc: Comma-separated pool: rbd:brutality, rbd:unyielding, rbd:regeneration, rbd:pursuit, rbd:vampirism. Empty disables boons.
gamerule.rbdPhantomBoonStrength.descript: 0.5 adds 50% attack/health/speed, or increases regeneration/lifesteal by 50%.
gamerule.rbdPhantomDefeatMiasmaRelief.de: Miasma removed from the target on defeat; copied equipment never drops.
gamerule.rbdPhantomAdaptiveAI.descriptio: Learns progression and melee/ranged/blocking/movement habits, unlocking strafing, flanking, interception and equipped double jumps.
gamerule.rbdPhantomLearningRate.descript: Multiplier for observed habits and incoming attacks; retained with the soul.
gamerule.rbdPhantomAttackIntervalTicks.d: Melee interval before learned speed adjustments, in ticks.
gamerule.rbdPhantomSkillIntervalTicks.de: Cooldown between copied weapon uses, in ticks.
gamerule.rbdPhantomPursuitDistance.descr: Distance beyond which the phantom seeks a safe teleport destination, in blocks.
gamerule.rbdPhantomUseCopiedItems.descri: Invokes native item use for weapons; third-party skills restricted to specific players or clients require integration.
gamerule.rbdPhantomUseCopiedCurios.descr: Copies all Curios slots and item data and runs their native equipment logic.
gamerule.rbdPhantomWeaponChargeTicks.des: Charge ticks passed to native bow/weapon release logic.
Pursuit speed fraction added per learned tier, from 0 to 3.
gamerule.rbdPhantomLearningAttackPerTier: Phantom: learned attack speed per tier
Attack interval = base interval / (1 + learned tier × this value).
gamerule.rbdPhantomRegenerationPerSecond: Base health restored per second by the regeneration boon, multiplied by boon strength.
gamerule.rbdPhantomLifestealRatio.descri: With vampirism, heal this fraction of actual melee health damage.
gamerule.rbdPhantomCanTeleport.descripti: Allows cross-dimension, long-distance and stuck pursuit teleports.
message.rbd.phantom.warning: Your miasma is taking your shape… it will arrive in about %s seconds.
message.rbd.phantom.arrival: It remembers your strength, and how you evade death.
message.rbd.phantom.phase_two: Despair Phantom: only %s is spared. All other living entities within %s blocks will be executed after %s seconds!
message.rbd.phantom.defeated: The phantom crumbles. Miasma reduced by %s; it still remembers this battle.
gamerule.rbdPhantomTacticalMovement.desc: Choose movement using the copied weapon and enable tactical dodges.
gamerule.rbdPhantomRangedMinDistance.des: Retreat below this distance when a usable ranged weapon is equipped.
gamerule.rbdPhantomRangedMaxDistance.des: Preferred spacing, not a limit on native weapon firing range.
gamerule.rbdPhantomDodgeProjectiles.desc: At learning tier 1 or higher, dodge projectiles predicted to hit.
gamerule.rbdPhantomDodgeLookaheadTicks.d: Look ahead this many ticks along incoming projectile trajectories.
gamerule.rbdPhantomDodgeDistance.descrip: Sidestep onto clear, supported ground; zero disables dodge movement.
gamerule.rbdPhantomDodgeSpeed.descriptio: Dodge movement relative to the phantom movement attribute.
gamerule.rbdPhantomReactionTicks.descrip: Ticks between incoming projectile threat checks.
gamerule.rbdPhantomPathIntervalTicks.des: Minimum normal repath interval; urgent dodges may update immediately.
gamerule.rbdPhantomFlankDistance.descrip: Preferred side offset for shield flanking and ranged movement.
gamerule.rbdPhantomInterceptTicks.descri: Predict intercept positions from observed movement, increasing with growth.
gamerule.rbdPhantomAimLeadTicks.descript: Maximum movement lead for native weapon aim; zero disables leading.
gamerule.rbdAutoCheckpoint.description: Automatically updates the shared world checkpoint during online play. Existing authored checkpoints remain available; no player manual-save action is added.
Default 12000 ticks = 10 minutes at 20 TPS. Pauses without online holders; resets after checkpoint capture or return.
gamerule.rbdAutoCheckpointSafeTicks.desc: Default 200 ticks = 10 seconds. All online holders must remain safe. Injury, low health, burning, falling, submersion, reading or a phantom hunt postpones saving.
gamerule.rbdAutoCheckpointMinHealthPerce: Minimum health percent for automatic checkpoint
Default 75%. Keeps the previous checkpoint while an online holder is below this health percentage.
gamerule.rbdMemoryWriteQueueMiB.descript: Default 64 MiB. Compresses and writes in order. A full buffer applies backpressure without dropping frames; one oversized frame is accepted alone at full resolution.
gamerule.rbdClientImageQueueMiB.descript: Default 64 MiB. Encodes captured PNG images in the background at the configured resolution and frequency. A full buffer applies backpressure.
gamerule.rbdReuseSnapshotFiles.descripti: Reuses unchanged files between immutable snapshots with full checksum verification. Live and restored worlds always have independent files. Falls back to copying when unsupported; applies on the next world open.
gamerule.rbdCheckpointRetention.descript: Default 1: retire older committed copies in the background after the new checkpoint is verified and the world reopens. Books and memories are preserved. Applies after the next save/return or world open.
gamerule.rbdFailedWorldRetention.descrip: Default 1: keep the most recent replaced world for recovery; 0 removes completed backups after a successful reopen. Incomplete transactions and fault evidence are preserved.
